d: Parveen Babi remains one of Bollywood’s most tragic and enduring stories. A glamorous actor who redefined what a Bollywood heroine could look like and represent, she seemingly disappeared from public life one day. After a series of controversial interviews, she was eventually found dead in her apartment. In the years since, countless theories and versions of her story have emerged. But behind the glamour, fame and headlines was a woman going through struggles that were far more complex than the public could see. In this video, we go beyond the myths and speculation to understand what…
